title: Ansible green ladder with four EU loadgen hosts

excluded_hosts.reason: Known bad 2-vCPU/4GB runner that dropped SSH mid-load in item 268.
JPN node; excluded from EU green runs because it adds cross-region latency.

preflight: LOADTEST_RUNNER_SSH_OPTS='-i ~/.ssh/id_n2_ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no' bash -lc 'read -r -a opts <<< "$LOADTEST_RUNNER_SSH_OPTS"; ssh "${opts[@]}" root@203.0.113.13 hostname'

attempts.name: 270a-40k-green
attempts.command: LOADTEST_RUNNER_SSH_OPTS='-i ~/.ssh/id_n2_ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no' LOADTEST_EXTERNAL_RUNNER_HOSTS='root@203.0.113.10 root@203.0.113.12 root@203.0.113.11 root@203.0.113.13' LOADTEST_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/and-live-270a-ansible-green-ladder-40k-60s LOADTEST_DRAIN_SECS=30 LOADTEST_BATCH_SIZE=8 LOADTEST_PIPELINE_DEPTH=4 LOADTEST_STRICT_NONCE_RETRY=0 LOADTEST_FAIL_ON_ERRORS=1 bash chain/scripts/loadtest_live_network_multi_ingress.sh /tmp/and-live-testnet 32 40000 60
attempts.reason: Clean low-load green rung with matching block/state roots and drained queues, but it only delivered 32.8k measured RPS against 40k offered.

attempts.name: 270b-60k-undrained-binned
attempts.command: LOADTEST_RUNNER_SSH_OPTS='-i ~/.ssh/id_n2_ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no' LOADTEST_EXTERNAL_RUNNER_HOSTS='root@203.0.113.10 root@203.0.113.12 root@203.0.113.11 root@203.0.113.13' LOADTEST_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/and-live-270b-ansible-green-ladder-60k-60s LOADTEST_DRAIN_SECS=30 LOADTEST_BATCH_SIZE=8 LOADTEST_PIPELINE_DEPTH=4 LOADTEST_STRICT_NONCE_RETRY=0 LOADTEST_FAIL_ON_ERRORS=1 bash chain/scripts/loadtest_live_network_multi_ingress.sh /tmp/and-live-testnet 32 60000 60
attempts.reason: The rung still converged on block/state root and had zero RPC/nonce/network errors, but validator-2 retained 324 mahi pre-admitted items after an extra 30s settle. That is not a fully drained green result, so the ladder stops here.

conclusion: The four-EU-runner setup is now valid and reproducible. Current main has a clean live green floor at 40k/60s, but it under-delivers to 32.8k measured RPS and 34.2k committed TPS. The first non-green rung is 60k/60s because validator-2 keeps a 324-item mahi pre-admitted tail after extra settle.
